short_description: Bitpanda GmbH is a Vienna-headquartered Austrian retail investment platform founded in 2014 by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer that gives European retail customers app-based access to cryptocurrencies, fractional shares, exchange-traded funds and precious metals. It supplies the same regulated trading, custody and settlement infrastructure to banks and financial institutions through Bitpanda Technology Solutions. In March 2021 Bitpanda became the first Austrian company to be valued above one billion US dollars, and in January 2025 it became the first large European crypto platform to hold a licence under the EU Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation.
